The latest run of task 11 actually used the **tft** model, even though an **auto** (validation tournament) was requested.

The reason the requested model was not used is: **nhits unavailable: no GPU worker**

This indicates that the nhits model, which was likely selected during the auto tournament validation process, could not run because there were no available GPU workers at the time, so the system fell back to using the tft model instead.
